description: This file defines route handlers for browser agent storage operations, including cookie management, local/session storage, offline mode, headers, credentials, geolocation, media emulation, timezone, locale, and device emulation, utilizing Playwright for browser automation.

methods.name: parseStorageKind
methods.description: Parses a string to determine if it is 'local' or 'session' storage kind.

methods.name: parseStorageMutationRequest
methods.description: Parses request parameters to determine storage kind and target ID.

methods.name: parseRequiredStorageMutationRequest
methods.description: Ensures storage mutation request has a valid storage kind and target ID.

methods.name: parseStorageMutationOrRespond
methods.description: Validates storage mutation request and responds with error if invalid.

methods.name: parseStorageMutationFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts and parses storage mutation data from HTTP request.

methods.name: registerBrowserAgentStorageRoutes
methods.description: Registers route handlers for browser storage and related operations.
